title: Design System: Joshua Alcobia Gomes — Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero headline, deck slide project titles. Tightest tracking in the system (-0.035em).

headline.purpose: Section headers on the home page and each project page's intro slide.

body.purpose: All prose — about-me copy, project summaries, bullet lists. Max readable measure ~65-75ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, section tags, project focus/detail labels. Always uppercase, widely tracked (+0.16em) — the sole reversal of the tightening rule.

shadows.name: ambient-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for small surfaces — fact cards, chips.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Default elevation for cards, buttons, the nav's bottom edge.

shadows.name: ambient-lg
shadows.purpose: Heaviest elevation — hero portrait, hover-lifted cards, deck slide media. Reserved for the single most prominent element on screen.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrance and reveal motion — decelerating, no overshoot.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Gentle-overshoot settle for section/slide entrances that follow a momentum gesture.

motion.name: deck-spring
motion.value: critically-damped spring, response ≈0.5s, damping 1.0 (JS-integrated, not CSS)
motion.purpose: Deck section-to-section snapping. Animates from the live scroll position, is interruptible mid-flight, and carries velocity through a re-target — the system's core fluid interaction.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid pill CTA — the system's highest-commitment action (e.g. 'Explore my work').
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; padding: .8rem 1.3rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; cursor: pointer; background: #2F4538; color: #F3ECDD; box-shadow: 0 18px 50px -18px rgba(47,69,56,.28); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .25s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 40px 90px -30px rgba(47,69,56,.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); transition-duration: .09s; } .ds-arrow { transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Translucent secondary action, used alongside a primary button (e.g. 'Download PDF portfolio').
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; padding: .8rem 1.3rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #dfe4d8; cursor: pointer; background: #ffffffbb; color: #2F4538; transition: background .25s, box-shadow .25s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), transform .12s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(47,69,56,.06); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Home-page navigation card linking to a project chapter (McLaren, NING Research, etc). Tints toward a per-card accent color on hover.

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .8rem; overflow: hidden; padding: 1.6rem; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid #dfe4d8; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); min-height: 220px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .45s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), border-color .3s; } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .45s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--ds-tint, #A8C3A4) 0%, transparent 70%); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 40px 90px -30px rgba(47,69,56,.35); border-color: transparent; } .ds-card:hover::before { opacity: .35; } .ds-card:active { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(.99); transition-duration: .1s; } .ds-card-tag { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7FA07B; } .ds-card h3 { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; margin: 0; } .ds-card p { position: relative; z-index: 1; color: #5c6b60; font-size: .95rem; margin: 0; } .ds-card-go { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-top: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: .92rem; color: #2F4538; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Small pill tag for skills and project focus labels.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 500; padding: .4rem .8rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dfe4d8; color: #43574a; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Sticky translucent glass nav with underline-on-active links and a mobile hamburger fallback.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 90; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: .85rem 2rem; backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%); background: rgba(251,250,246,.62); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(47,69,56,.06); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5) inset, 0 8px 24px -18px rgba(47,69,56,.5); } .ds-nav-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-nav-mark { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #A8C3A4, #B8D4E3); color: #2F4538; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: .35rem; } .ds-nav-links a { position: relative; padding: .5rem .8rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .93rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5c6b60; text-decoration: none; transition: color .25s, background .25s, transform .12s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: #2F4538; } .ds-nav-links a:active { transform: scale(.93); } .ds-nav-links a[aria-current='page'] { color: #2F4538; background: #ffffff9c; }

components.name: Deck Progress Rail
components.description: Vertical stack of uniform pill bars tracking scroll position through a project page's deck. Signature navigation component.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: .45rem; margin-top: 1rem; } .ds-rail-dot { width: 4px; height: 15px; border-radius: 3px; background: #dfe4d8; opacity: .55; border: 0; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background .35s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), opacity .35s; } .ds-rail-dot:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-rail-dot:active { opacity: 1; transform: scaleX(1.4); } .ds-rail-dot.ds-active { opacity: 1; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #7FA07B, #8FB8CE); }

narrative.overview: The design gets out of the way of real engineering work. Every screen leads with content — a project, a CFD render, a bullet of measurable outcome — and the interface exists only to present it clearly and let it be scanned quickly. Nothing decorative is added that doesn't earn its place: no illustration, no stock texture, no filler copy. The one indulgence the system allows itself is a soft, natural pastel atmosphere (sage, sky, sand) and a small set of fluid, spring-physics interactions (instant press feedback, an interruptible pinned 'deck' that snaps between projects) — restraint in content, craft in motion. This system currently serves both a student-placement portfolio and, longer-term, the seed of a professional consulting brand. That dual audience is why the palette stays warm and human rather than corporate-neutral, while typography and layout stay precise and legible enough to read as professional evidence, not a hobby page.
keyCharacteristics: Pastel, nature-derived palette (sage / sky / sand) against a warm off-white base, with deep forest-ink text for contrast and legibility.
Large, tightly-tracked geometric display type (Space Grotesk) paired with a calm, near-zero-tracked body face (Inter).
Pill-shaped interactive controls everywhere (buttons, chips, nav links) — soft, rounded, never sharp-cornered.
A pinned, one-project-per-viewport 'deck' for project pages, with a vertical progress rail and spring-physics section snapping.
Translucent 'glass' chrome (blurred, saturated backdrop) on the nav and floating surfaces; flat pastel gradients as ambient background, not photography.
Real content only — every claim traces to actual project work; unfinished projects are explicitly marked, never disguised as complete.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: All text-on-light color comes from Forest Ink, Soft Ink, or Muted Moss — three steps of the same hue, never a separate gray scale. This is what keeps the palette feeling like one warm material rather than pastel accents on a generic gray UI.

rules.name: The Accent-as-Tint Rule
rules.body: Sage, sky, and sand are never used as solid text-background pairs for body copy; they appear as gradients, ambient blobs, hover tints, and small pill-chip fills only. Ink-on-paper carries all reading contrast.

rules.name: The Optical Tightening Rule
rules.body: Letter-spacing is never one fixed value. It runs from -0.035em at display size down to -0.004em at body size, then reverses to +0.16em for all-caps labels. Every type role's tracking is chosen for its own size, never copy-pasted from another role.

rules.name: The Glass-Not-Glossy Rule
rules.body: Floating chrome (nav, translucent card surfaces) uses backdrop-filter blur+saturate over a semi-transparent background — never a flat opaque bar. It respects prefers-reduced-transparency by falling back to a solid background with the blur removed, never by leaving a broken half-state.

dos: Do keep all body/heading text on the Forest Ink → Soft Ink → Muted Moss scale; never introduce a separate gray.
Do give every interactive element instant :active press feedback (scale, not a delayed transition).
Do let project media keep its native aspect ratio, rounded corners, no cropping — the frame adapts to the photo, not the other way round.
Do mark unfinished projects/pages explicitly (dashed border, placeholder styling) rather than disguising them as complete, per the real-content-only product principle.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion (drop the spring/deck-snap for a plain fade) and prefers-reduced-transparency (solid backgrounds, no blur) as first-class states, not afterthoughts.
donts: Don't use a hard-edged drop shadow or a dark/heavy border anywhere — depth comes from soft ambient shadow and translucency only.
Don't crop a project photo or video into a fixed box; size the frame to the media.

Don't invent a white/grey schematic-sketch palette under this file's authority — that direction was described by Joshua as an aspiration, not adopted; it requires a deliberate redesign pass (new-work), not a quiet blend into the current tokens.
Don't add decorative illustration, stock photography, or filler copy — every element must earn its place per 'The Quiet Portfolio' north star.
Don't fabricate metrics, testimonials, or client claims — PRODUCT.md's real-content-only principle is binding on this visual system too.
